title: packages: POST /packages/:id/commits/:commitId/revert ignores :id — a commit of package A reverts through package B's path, and lands a revert commit in A's history after A was uninstalled
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbWJDYbbtH6dhJNoboN

立卡门: ① 产品缺陷，具名落点 + 复现（reach: 公开入口 HTTP `POST /api/v1/packages/:id/commits/:commitId/revert` 实测一次错误结果）
业务理由: 用脚本或 Studio 按包回滚的管理员，提交号一旦串错包，就会悄悄回滚另一个包的元数据（创建的条目被软删、编辑的被还原），而且回应 200、没有任何提示；即便那个包已卸载，也会往它的历史里再写一条 revert 提交。路径里的包 id 形同虚设，审计时也看不出是从哪个包发起的。
动手的读者: domain:server 席，`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` 的 `commits/:commitId/revert` 分支（约 L2419）：读 `parts[0]`，提交不属于该包则 404（如 COMMIT_NOT_FOUND）；并比照约 L2506 的 `POST /packages/:id/revert` 决定要不要 `requireWritablePackage`。
查重: `commit revert wrong package` 1129 命中（噪声）、`revertCommit` 68、`commits revert package id` 593（均含已关）；最近邻 #21821（revertCommit 恢复分支的类型复数问题，开）、#27868、#25278、#24705（都已关，别的门）都不是本现象。

QA-source: #28981 · platform-core.package-lifecycle-enable-disable · observed beside the clauses

## What happens
The per-commit revert door takes the commit id from the path and never reads the package id beside it:
- `POST /api/v1/packages/B/commits/COMMIT_OF_A/revert` answers 200 and reverts package A's items;
- it then writes a "Revert: …" commit into A's history, even when A was already uninstalled (`GET /packages/A/commits` lists it).

The caller still needs `manage_metadata`, so this is not an authorization hole; it is the door doing something other than what its path names. On a stock boot no read-only package carries commits (`GET /packages/com.example.showcase/commits` → `[]`), so whether a read-only package's commit can be reverted this way was not reachable here.

Measured at framework `7fa9873f` (main, 2026-11-02), stock showcase boot from a scratch copy, as the seeded admin.

## Reproduction
1. As admin, create two writable packages A (`com.qa.r5probe`) and B (`com.qa.r5probe2`) with `POST /api/v1/packages`, put a draft into each and `POST /api/v1/packages/ID/publish-drafts`.
2. Read A's first commit id from `GET /api/v1/packages/com.qa.r5probe/commits`. (A may be uninstalled at this point.)
3. `POST /api/v1/packages/com.qa.r5probe2/commits/A_COMMIT_ID/revert` with `{}`.
4. **Expected:** 404 naming the commit as not in package B, or a refusal naming the mismatch.
5. **Actual:** 200 `{revertedCount: 3, reverted: [r5p_app removed, r5p_widget.all_widgets removed, r5p_widget removed]}`; `GET /packages/com.qa.r5probe/commits` now holds 4 entries, the newest "Revert: first publish".

## Mechanism (read at 7fa9873f)
The branch passes only `commitId` (and the actor) to `protocol.revertCommit`; `parts[0]` is unused. The sibling `POST /packages/:id/revert` resolves the package and calls `requireWritablePackage`.
